messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a zipline canary for inference-serv v2 at 10:00 PST today. Target ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~40m. Window 10:00-11:00. Need smoke owners + rollback ready.
Sam: I can own smoke checks. Will watch latency, p50/p95, error-rate. Which cohort are we using?
Alex: Using 'greylayer' cohort (US-west subset). Config: cohort-id=zip-greylayer-2026.
Priya: I'll wire up the telemetry alerts. Can you drop the sample prompt set you want exercised?
Alex: Sure — quick set attached below. Run these 5 prompts against /v1/complete and check response time + mismatch rate.
Marta: FYI the infra patch for kv-cache landed in canary yesterday — low risk but calling it out.
Jamal: PR #4821 is queued for prod deploy (infra+api). Alex, did you validate compatibility with the quantized variant?
Alex: Yep — smoke on staging passed with 2% sample. Quantized variant falls back cleanly.
Sam: Roll steps I suggest: 
1) 10:00 1% (5m smoke)
2) 10:10 5% (15m smoke)
3) 10:30 20% (20m observation)
Will abort if p95 latency > 600ms or errors > 0.5%.
Alex: Sounds good. Add rollback trigger: sustained error-rate > 0.3% for 5m.
Priya: Alerts created: infra.latency.p95, inference.errors.rate, routing.traffic-shift. Notifications go to #oncall and @Sam.
DeployBot: Rollout scheduled by Alex for 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z (10:00 PST). Canary plan: zipline/greylayer.
Sam: Quick smoke checklist I'll run:
- hit /health on each pod
- run sample prompts (small set)
- check KV cache hit ratio
- validate token-level cost looks sane
- confirm no rate-limit spikes
Sam: I'll post results in-thread after each step.
Marta: Ops note — autoscaler should be pinned to min=8 for this cohort to avoid transient scaling noise. I set that already.
Jamal: Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-serv inference-serv=registry.redwood/inference-serv:v2-rollback
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-serv
```
Alex: Thanks. Also keep the canary variant pinned to the older kernel as fallback (config id: kernel-1.9).
Priya: Telemetry: I'll mute non-actionable noisy alerts during ramp and enable a high-sensitivity regression detection for the prompt set.
Sam: 10:02 — 1% deployed. Starting 5m smoke now.
Sam: 10:07 — smoke OK. p95=210ms, errors=0.04%, KV hit=72%. Proceeding to 5%. :thumbsup:
Sam: 10:18 — 5% steady. p95=230ms, errors=0.07%. Advancing to 20%.
DeployBot: Canary progress: 1% -> 5% -> 20% (in progress).
Priya: Watching telemetry; no regressions so far. Minor latency bump expected.
Alex: If anything odd, call abort and run rollback command. Otherwise rotate to full release schedule at 11:00.
Sam: 10:42 — 20% steady. p95=245ms, errors=0.09%. All checks green.
Marta: Confirmed autoscaler stable. No crashloops.
Jamal: Merging PR #4821 now.
Alex: Great work team. Leave this thread open for any post-roll observations. I'll post final confirmation once we hit 100% or rollback. :partyparrot:
notes: Deployment coordination for canary ramp; contains commands, thresholds, and smoke checklist.
